From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Demo → Eval metrics instrumentation (standard demo tenant)

Isabelle / team —

As we roll out Standard Demo v1, I’d like to instrument “demo → eval” conversion in a way we can trust week over week (and not rely on anecdotal SE notes).

A few questions so I can spec this cleanly:

1) What’s the source of truth for “a demo happened” today — meeting logged in HubSpot? calendar? SE notes? 
2) Do we want to measure conversion at the Company level or Deal level (or both)?
3) How do we want to define “eval started” for this initiative:
   - first API key created in a prospect tenant?
   - first billable token / usage above $0?
   - first “trial workspace” provisioned?
4) For the demo tenant specifically, can we tag requests by scenario (streaming, tool calling, fallback routing, cost dashboard) so we can correlate which scenarios drive eval starts?

I drafted proposed HubSpot fields + event taxonomy (links below). If we align this week, we can get an initial dashboard live before the enablement trainings.

Attachment: Demo-to-Eval Metrics (Proposed HubSpot fields) v0.1 - Google Sheet
Attachment: Demo Tenant Event Taxonomy v0.1 - Google Doc

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Growth Marketing, Redwood Inference

From: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 10:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo → Eval metrics instrumentation (standard demo tenant)

Ben —

Good timing. Current state is messy:

1) “Demo happened” is usually a Meeting + a note on the Deal, but not consistently. Some reps log it as a call; some don’t.
2) We generally report conversion at Deal stage (Demo Scheduled → Evaluation), but for this project I’d like Company-level too (multiple deals sometimes).
3) Eval start definition: Sales Ops uses “Evaluation” stage entry, but that’s a human action. We should pair it with a product signal if we can (e.g., first API key created / first request in non-demo tenant).

Re: tagging scenarios — if we can add a consistent header and/or enforce naming in scripts, that’d be ideal.

If you can propose the minimal set of HubSpot properties (not 20+) I can get them created and added to the meeting/deal form. We should keep it simple for reps.

-Isabelle

Isabelle Laurent
CRM Workflow Owner (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 12:07 PM PST
Subject: Re: Demo → Eval metrics instrumentation (standard demo tenant)

Adding SE perspective:

- Reps will not reliably select 5 scenarios after a call. We can probably get them to pick 1–2.
- For scenario tagging: our demo scripts could add a header like `x-redwood-demo-scenario: streaming_chat`.
- We also need a way to flag “Plan B used” (e.g., we had to switch models/regions or use canned output). That’s important for demo reliability rate.

If Logan can pull scenario counts from logs, we could avoid manual scenario selection entirely (but understand that may be too much for v1).

Markus

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 2:41 PM PST
Subject: Re: Demo → Eval metrics instrumentation (standard demo tenant)

We can support lightweight telemetry for the demo tenant without too much product work IF:

1) Requests from demo scripts include a stable scenario header (as Markus said).
2) We also include a stable “actor” tag (AE/SE) or at least a user id / API key mapping (we already have API key id; mapping to user is internal).
3) We keep taxonomy small and do not try to encode every narrative branch.

For “eval started,” we can generate a product signal:
- first API key created in a non-demo tenant linked to that account (if/when we have account mapping)
- OR simplest: first request from a non-demo tenant where the email domain matches the prospect

Caveat: domain matching can be noisy for consultants/partners.

Logan

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 15, 2025 at 9:28 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo → Eval metrics instrumentation (standard demo tenant)

Thanks all. Here’s a proposed V1 that hits Talia’s Feb 3 timing and keeps rep burden low.

V1 (CRM) — create 6 properties

A) On MEETING (preferred) + copy to Deal via workflow:
1. Standard Demo Used (checkbox)
2. Demo Tenant Used (checkbox) [separate from Standard Demo Used in case they did a custom demo]
3. Primary Demo Scenario (dropdown, single select)
   - Streaming Chat
   - Tool Calling / Structured Output
   - Routing + Fallback Reliability
   - Cost/Latency Controls (batching/caching)
   - Observability (dashboards + error analysis)
   - Dedicated / Private Deployment Narrative (no live env change)
4. Plan B Used? (checkbox)
5. Plan B Type (dropdown, optional)
   - Switched model variant
   - Switched region
   - Used canned output
   - Skipped console step
   - Other

B) On DEAL:
6. Eval Started Date (date) — if we can’t automate yet, we’ll drive this via stage entry + a required date field.

V1 (product telemetry) — optional but high leverage

- In demo scripts, add `x-redwood-demo-scenario` with 1 of the same values above.
- Add `x-redwood-demo-run-id` (uuid) so we can group a “demo session” even if it’s multiple requests.
- If feasible, add `x-redwood-demo-actor` (AE/SE) — can be optional.

Dashboards (initial)

1) Funnel: Meetings w/ Standard Demo Used → Deals entering Evaluation stage (weekly)
2) Conversion by primary scenario
3) Demo reliability: % with Plan B used + top Plan B types

Owners / asks

- Isabelle: sanity-check property placement (meeting vs deal) + confirm what’s realistic to make required
- Logan: confirm we can safely ingest/aggregate scenario header for demo tenant traffic (no PII; demo prompts are sanitized)
- Markus/Talia: confirm the scenario dropdown labels match the talk track and won’t change every week

If this is acceptable, I’ll revise the sheet and we can consider “V2” to automate eval-start via product signals.

Ben

This works.

Notes / decisions:

- We’ll implement properties on Meetings and use an automation to copy the values to the associated Deal (so AE logging a meeting updates the deal).
- We’ll make “Standard Demo Used” + “Primary Demo Scenario” required on the meeting form used by Sales/SE for demos.
- “Plan B Used” will be optional but strongly recommended (we can add it to the checklist / training).

Ben — if you update the sheet with the final property names (exact strings), I’ll create them in HubSpot tomorrow and share the internal “how to log a demo” snippet for the enablement email.

Logan — separate thread for the header-based telemetry so we don’t block the CRM setup.

-Isabelle
